name: personal-homepage
description: Simple personal site with just a homepage. Should produce WebSite, Person, and ProfilePage nodes with proper @id linking.

scripted_user_replies: It's just the one page — no blog, no portfolio section, just an about-me homepage. The domain is janekim.dev. I'm a product designer at Stripe. My profiles: github.com/janekim, linkedin.com/in/janekimdesign, and I'm @janekim on Mastodon (mastodon.design).
That sounds right — WebSite, Person, and ProfilePage. I don't need BreadcrumbList since it's a single page. Let's go with that.
